summary: Ukrainian naval drones struck a Russian supply vessel and a Krasukha-4 electronic warfare station in Crimea, degrading Russian radar coverage. Russian Geran-5 reactive UAVs launched from approximately 400 km targeted Kyiv for a second consecutive day, hitting residential areas. The Russian Ministry of Defense claimed liberation of four settlements in Kharkiv region and the DPR.
key_points: Ukrainian naval drone attacked 3600-tonne Russian supply vessel NEFRIT in Sochi port and destroyed Krasukha-4 EW station in Sevastopol. (Source: @eRadarrua/110443)

Russian Geran-5 reactive UAVs launched from ~400 km struck Kyiv's Holosiivskyi district and Bazhana avenue for second consecutive day. (Source: @UkraineNow/83864, @eRadarrua/110483, @mon1tor_ua/73590)
Russian MoD claims liberation of Vasilevka, Blagodatnoe, Dolzhanka in Kharkiv region and Izhevka in DPR. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32968)
Shootout between GUR and SBU personnel in Kyiv resulted in two suspects charged; separate investigation into missing RDK fighter. (Source: @UkraineNow/83866)

Germany plans to supply thousands of strike drones and Iris-T missiles in September, enhance intelligence cooperation after attributing Leipzig airport drone incident to Russia. (Source: @UkraineNow/83863)
Russian strikes on fuel depots and military bases halved AFU fuel supplies per Russian security structures. (Source: @tass_agency/393612)
Estonian Defence Minister resigned over failed €70M artillery shell procurement for Ukraine via Indian companies; Ukraine never received ammunition. (Source: @UkraineNow/83861)

Multiple reactive UAV waves detected from Orel, Dnipropetrovsk, Chernihiv, Poltava, Donbas targeting Kyiv, Poltava, Cherkasy, Vinnytsia regions. (Source: @eRadarrua/110439, @mon1tor_ua/73593, @eRadarrua/110445)

sections.executive_summary: Ukrainian naval drones conducted a significant strike on Russian naval assets in Sochi and Crimea, destroying a supply vessel and a long-range electronic warfare station. Russia intensified its air campaign with new Geran-5 reactive UAVs striking Kyiv from 400 km range for a second day. Russian ground forces claimed incremental territorial gains in Kharkiv region and the DPR.

points: Ukrainian naval drone struck the 3600-tonne Russian supply vessel NEFRIT in Sochi port, which serviced offshore oil and gas infrastructure and military logistics. (Source: @eRadarrua/110443)

Ukrainian forces destroyed a Krasukha-4 long-range electronic warfare station (1RL257) in occupied Sevastopol, significantly weakening Russian radar suppression over Crimea. (Source: @eRadarrua/110443)
Ukrainian air defense intercepted new Russian Geran-5 reactive UAVs over Kyiv for a second consecutive day; the drones were launched from approximately 400 km distance. (Source: @UkraineNow/83864)

A shootout between GUR and SBU personnel in Kyiv led to two suspects being charged with weapons violations; a separate investigation was opened into the disappearance of an RDK GUR fighter. (Source: @UkraineNow/83866)

Estonian Defence Minister Pevkur resigned over a failed €70 million artillery shell procurement for Ukraine via Indian companies; Ukraine never received the ordered ammunition. (Source: @UkraineNow/83861)

Germany plans to deliver thousands of strike drones and Iris-T missiles to Ukraine in September, enhance intelligence cooperation, and assist with target coordinates for counterattacks after attributing a drone incident at Leipzig airport to Russia. (Source: @UkraineNow/83863)
The Russian Ministry of Defense claimed liberation of Vasilevka, Blagodatnoe, and Dolzhanka in Kharkiv region and Izhevka in the DPR. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32968)

Russian forces launched Geran-5 reactive UAVs from approximately 400 km, striking Kyiv's Holosiivskyi district causing a fire in a residential building and hitting near Bazhana avenue. (Source: @eRadarrua/110483, @mon1tor_ua/73590)
Russian strikes on Ukrainian fuel depots and military bases have halved fuel supplies for the AFU, with Ukrainian military reportedly complaining of shortages. (Source: @tass_agency/393612)
Reactive UAV launches from Orel continued with new waves expected; multiple Shaheds detected targeting Kyiv, Poltava, Cherkasy, and Vinnytsia regions. (Source: @eRadarrua/110439, @mon1tor_ua/73593)
A Russian attack damaged the Coca-Cola beverage plant near Velyka Dymerka in Brovary district, Kyiv region, causing a large-scale fire. (Source: @eRadarrua/110438)
Russian MoD claimed liberation of Vasilevka, Blagodatnoe, Dolzhanka in Kharkiv region and Izhevka in the DPR. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32968)
A reactive UAV was detected heading towards Semenivka in Poltava region from the southeast. (Source: @kpszsu/76189)
Four reactive Shaheds launched from Dnipropetrovsk region towards Poltava, Poltava district. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73593)
One reactive Shahed launched from Donbas towards Dnipropetrovsk, Pavlohrad district. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73593)
At least three reactive UAVs from northern Dnipropetrovsk moved towards Poltava, with the first passing Pereshchepyne. (Source: @eRadarrua/110445)
A reactive Shahed launched from Chernihiv region towards Kyiv, Vyshhorod district. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73593)
Chernihiv region reported a 10-minute period without new drone activity. (Source: @eRadarrua/110461)
Russian forces attacked the University of Food Technologies in Kyiv. (Source: @UkraineNow/83858)
A reactive UAV passed Krasiatychi in Kyiv region moving in a southwesterly direction. (Source: @kpszsu/76181)
At least four reactive UAVs from Dnipropetrovsk transited Poltava region northbound towards Cherkasy. (Source: @eRadarrua/110423)
Ukrainian naval drone attacked the 3600-tonne Russian supply vessel NEFRIT in Sochi port (Krasnodar Krai) and destroyed a Krasukha-4 EW station in Sevastopol. (Source: @eRadarrua/110443)
A reactive UAV targeted Berezanka in Mykolaiv region from the northeast. (Source: @kpszsu/76196)
A high-speed transport-landing boat BK-16 (20.5 tonnes) was hit in the Sevastopol area. (Source: @eRadarrua/110443)
The Russian supply vessel NEFRIT was attacked while performing underwater technical works for offshore oil and gas objects and military logistics. (Source: @eRadarrua/110443)
Ukrainian air defense shot down new Russian Geran-5 reactive UAVs over Kyiv for a second consecutive day; the drones were launched from approximately 400 km. (Source: @UkraineNow/83864)

Multiple reactive Shahed waves detected: four from Dnipropetrovsk to Poltava; one from Chernihiv to Kyiv Vyshhorod; one from Poltava to Kyiv Boryspil; one from Donbas to Dnipropetrovsk Pavlohrad; one towards Vinnytsia/Zhytomyr. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73593)
Reactive UAV launches from Orel continued with expectations of new waves. (Source: @eRadarrua/110439)
